absent: Charge calculation and release semantics and failure causes
Page table relocation mechanics and partial move causes
Unmap implementation, iterator behaviour and split failure handling
Merge decision rules for copied, new and extended ranges
Driver split, open, close and remap hook contracts
Userfaultfd completion, failure and unmap completion effects
Huge reservation repair and granularity derivation

findings.text: Remap preparation hook for userfaultfd observes the destination area after table movement. When no monitor context is attached it returns silently, when event delivery is enabled it retains a reference and marks the address space as changing under protection, otherwise it detaches the context.

Destination area constructor for remap either merges the requested range into neighbours or allocates and links a fresh descriptor. Overlap with an existing occupied range, allocation failure, policy duplication failure, anonymous linkage failure or link failure yields absence of a destination.
Range extension helper grows a given area forward by a length, allowing absorption of a compatible successor. It builds a merge request anchored at the old end and delegates the merge decision.

Address space occupancy guard accounts worst case descriptor creation before any mutation. It adds two for unmaps that may split neighbours when requested, always adds two for the move itself, and adds one more when the source was already split, then requires the total to remain within the configured ceiling.

Two wrappers select guard parameters for different phases. The late variant derives the split condition from lock state of the source, the early variant treats any keep source request as split and includes the pre unmap cost.
Early split is required exactly when the caller asks to keep the source mapping while the source area is locked. All other combinations proceed without an early split.

Move preparation fails fast on occupancy exhaustion, consults the driver split veto at each needed boundary, asks the shared page merging facility to dissolve shared pages over the moved range without altering flags, and for locked keep source mappings performs splits ahead of time and marks cached iterators stale.

Source teardown preserves memory charge correctness by temporarily clearing the charge mark on accountable non keep source moves, performing the unmap, then restoring the mark on surviving neighbours located on each side. Split failure during unmap is compensated by reclaiming charge for the whole length.

Copy and transfer stage creates the destination, records source and destination in a table move request, relocates page table entries, and consults the driver remap hook. Short transfer or driver error triggers relocation back to the source and retargets later teardown at the destination, success arms event notification, and reservation repair always runs.

Destination merge policy normalises offsets of never faulted areas toward the destination to aid merging, suppresses probe page installation when the source is file backed, forbids merging source into itself when the source is retained, tolerates replacement only for unfaulted coalescence immediately around the old start, and otherwise duplicates policy and linkage with ordered release on failure.

Keep source completion forbids identity between source and destination, clears all locked marks on the source, and when the entire source extent was relocated detaches anonymous linkage and resets unfaulted offsets to the start shifted form, extending the reset to the file offset for purely anonymous areas.

Relocation pipeline runs preparation, charge calculation, exclusive access to the source, copy with table transfer, conditional keep source completion, statistical accounting for the new extent, selective teardown of the appropriate extent, and restoration of the high water mark that was transiently inflated.

Shrinking unmaps the tail beyond the new length and discards the cached descriptor. When the caller transfers lock ownership the descriptor records unlocked state, otherwise it reloads the descriptor at the base and reports absence as a fault.

Directed remap first clears the fixed destination and revalidates the possibly disturbed source, collapses a shrink before moving by normalising lengths, enforces growth quota for keep source expansion, resolves the destination address, then delegates to the relocation pipeline.

In place growth is possible only when the requested range ends exactly at the end of its area, the extended end does not wrap, no other area intersects the extension, and a fixed unmapped probe over the enlarged span succeeds.

In place extension charges before mutation, delegates growth and possible successor absorption to the merge facility, releases the charge when merging fails, and on success updates the cached descriptor and accounts statistics for the added extent.
Huge page handling rounds both lengths up to the page granularity, rejects any base or destination that is not aligned to the huge mask, and rejects any request that would enlarge the reservation.

Top level dispatch distinguishes no resize as immediate success, shrink as in place tail removal with lock release, expand via the growth path, and an invalid marker as a warning with invalid argument. Growth prefers in place extension and otherwise requires permission to move before selecting a destination and relocating.

Two predicates classify operations. New mapping is implied by growth or by any request that implies a fresh destination address. Pure movement holds only for fixed requests with identical old and new lengths.
Event reporting completes both early and late unmap phases in all outcomes, delivering a failure signal when the operation failed and a remap completion with old base, new base and length otherwise.

Occupancy evaluation requires the address space lock held for writing. The source area is placed under exclusive access before copying. Neighbour charge mark restoration takes exclusive access per neighbour. Monitor changing state is incremented while holding its dedicated changing lock for writing.

The remap request aggregates source descriptor, old base with old length, new base with new length, byte delta, mode flags, resize classification, charge state, two unmap notification contexts plus one remap notification context, and booleans recording iterator staleness and lock ownership.

Resource exhaustion during limit validation, charging, destination creation or partial table transfer surfaces as out of memory. Loss of the source descriptor after invalidation surfaces as a fault. An unreachable resize classification warns and surfaces as invalid argument. Transient inflation of total size is hidden by restoring the high water mark.
Behaviour is governed by mode options that keep the source mapped, pin the destination address, and permit relocation, together with a resize classification of invalid, unchanged, shrink and expand.

Statistical accounting converts the affected byte count to pages, applies generic flag based accounting against the current address space, and additionally accumulates locked pages when the source area carries the locked mark.
